intro.title: Build type guards for unknown API payloads
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple function that validates data from an external API. You will learn how to create a type guard, which is a TypeScript function that checks if unknown data matches a specific shape or type. The main technologies involved are TypeScript's type predicates and object property checking. By the end, you'll be able to safely handle unpredictable API responses in your applications.
intro.usecase: When building applications that consume external APIs, you often receive data with uncertain structure that TypeScript can't validate at compile time. This happens in dashboards displaying third-party analytics, e-commerce platforms integrating payment gateways, or social media apps showing user-generated content. Type guards let you safely validate API responses before rendering data in UI components like charts, product listings, or user profiles, preventing runtime errors while maintaining type safety throughout your application.
